methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 widely-searched home-theater AV receivers released 2020–2023 spanning entry, mid, upper-mid, and premium tiers from Denon, Marantz, Yamaha, Sony, Onkyo, and Anthem. Specs were independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages and spec manuals (denon.com, marantz.com, manuals.marantz.com, usa.yamaha.com, manual.yamaha.com, anthemav.com, onkyo.com) cross-checked with major retailers (Best Buy, Sweetwater, B&H) and specialist coverage (Audioholics, Crutchfield, What Hi-Fi, AVForums). Watts per channel are rated at 8 ohm 20 Hz–20 kHz 2-channel driven unless otherwise noted; hdmi_inputs_8k counts only HDMI ports capable of 8K/60Hz or 4K/120Hz; dolby_atmos is true/false; priceUsd is US MSRP (current list, or documented launch price where noted). Adversarial pass corrected 3 fields: Denon X4800H release year (2022→2023), Marantz Cinema 70s price ($1,199→$1,300), Onkyo TX-NR6100 release year (2022→2021). Sony STR-AN1000 watts_per_channel_8ohm intentionally null (rated at 6 ohm). accessedAt 2026-06-19.
